description: This file defines a service module for retrieving and aggregating Large Language Model (LLM) cost data by agent. It includes functions to build MongoDB aggregation pipelines for different data schemas, an in-process fallback aggregator, and an exported async function that attempts to fetch aggregated LLM cost data from a database collection using various strategies.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for documents with flat schema containing agent identifiers and total cost fields, handling various possible field names and sanitizing total cost values.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Builds a MongoDB pipeline for documents where agent info is stored as an array of objects with 'Agent Name' and 'Total Cost' fields, summing costs per agent.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Performs in-process aggregation over an array of documents with 'Agents' arrays, computing total costs per agent with 6-decimal precision, used as fallback when database aggregation fails.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main exported asynchronous function that attempts to retrieve LLM cost data aggregated by agent from multiple collections and schemas, falling back to in-process aggregation if database pipelines fail, and returns an array of agents with their total costs.
